name: Fort Valen
source:
Fort Valen is a short murder mystery story completed as part of a university project in which you play as a young adult Vishara Vakricustos attempting to solve the sudden killings of the guards around the fort she calls home. The main problem? Her mother: The Matron of Fort Valen.

After being injured at a young age Vishara has been kept within the walls of the fort which makes searching for evidence a considerable amount more difficult. Doing what young adults do best, and with the help of a spiritual companion who has been in her family for generations, Vishara must sneak from the fort to find some inkling of who is killing the guards before they can get to her mother... maybe then she might let you leave the fort.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Fort Valen》是一部作为大学项目完成的短篇谋杀悬疑故事。你将扮演年轻的维沙拉·瓦克里库斯托斯，试图查清她称之为家的堡垒周围，卫兵突然接连遇害的真相。而最大的障碍？正是她的母亲——瓦伦堡的女主人。

幼年受伤后，维沙拉便一直被留在堡垒的高墙内，让搜寻证据变得格外困难。借助一位世代陪伴家族的灵体伙伴，她得发挥年轻人最擅长的本领，偷偷溜出堡垒，赶在凶手对母亲下手之前，找出杀害卫兵之人的蛛丝马迹……也许到那时，母亲就会允许你离开堡垒了。

（摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251180/]Steam[/url]）
